title: Lumen Drift
theme: A tranquil void where soft geometric constellations pulse with gentle light, waiting to be connected by drifting energy threads that bloom into bridges of pure illumination.
mechanics: Tap to select a glowing node, then drag to draw a path to a matching colored node
Paths become permanent luminous bridges that cannot cross each other
Complete all node pairs in each level to advance
Hand-authored constellation layouts with light procedural color variation
Limited moves per level with move counter visible
